Astrowar.name: Astrowar
Astrowar.summary: Astrowar is an Action game, developed by Starsoft and published by Artic, which was cancelled before it was released.

Donkey Kong.name: Donkey Kong
Donkey Kong.summary: The Atari 2600 port of the hit arcade Donkey Kong differs from the original version in gameplay and has two stages instead of the original four.

RealSports Volleyball.name: RealSports Volleyball
RealSports Volleyball.summary: RealSports Volleyball is an enhanced version of programmer Bob Polaro's never released game Volleyball. He asked to make several improvements on it, including better animations and more colourful backgrounds. It is part of the RealSports series of games.

Video Pinball ~ Arcade Pinball.name: Video Pinball
Video Pinball ~ Arcade Pinball.summary: Video Pinball is a loose simulation of an arcade pinball machine: ball launcher, flippers, bumpers, and spinners.
